BillHeading.BriefDescription: Imposing a business and occupation tax surcharge on the operators of private detention facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to imposing a business and occupation tax surcharge on the operators of private detention facilities; and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) Beginning July 1, 2026, in addition to all other taxes imposed under this chapter, persons must pay a surcharge on Washington taxable income arising from operating a private detention facility as defined in RCW 70.395.020 if the person has annual Washington gross receipts in excess of $1,000,000.
(2) The rate of the surcharge is one percent of taxable income attributable to the operation of a private detention facility.
